therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of dopaminergic hyperactivity underlying psychotic symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with psychosis (delusions and/or hallucinations) associated with Alzheimer's type dementia
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in NPI Psychosis Subscale Score at Week 10

results.effect_size: ANCOVA mean difference -1.02 (95% CI: -2.49 to 0.44); ANOVA mean difference 0.17 (95% CI: -1.15 to 1.49)
subgroup_findings: NPI Psychosis Subscale change from baseline at Week 10: aripiprazole -6.55 vs placebo -5.52 (not statistically significant, p=0.169 by ANCOVA)
BPRS total score showed numerically greater improvement with aripiprazole vs placebo at Week 10 (-8.53 vs -6.28)
MMSE total score: aripiprazole showed slight worsening (-0.81) vs placebo improvement (+0.53) at Week 10; ANOVA p=0.001 favoring placebo
Extension phase (open-label aripiprazole): NPI Psychosis Subscale continued to improve through Week 140 (mean change -13.12 at Week 140)
CGI Improvement scores during extension phase remained in the 'much improved' to 'minimally improved' range throughout
safety_signals: In acute phase: 4 deaths in aripiprazole arm vs 0 in placebo arm
More any-AE in aripiprazole (67/105) vs placebo (53/103) in acute phase
More SAEs in aripiprazole (16/105) vs placebo (9/103) in acute phase
More discontinuations due to AE in aripiprazole (11/105) vs placebo (7/103) in acute phase
EPS-related AEs were low and similar between arms in acute phase
In extension phase (open-label aripiprazole, n=161): 41 deaths, 59 SAEs, 148 any-AE, 66 discontinuations due to AE over up to 130 weeks
Extrapyramidal disorder reported in 14 patients during extension phase
Lung disorder SAE in 5/161 extension patients; femur fracture in 4/161
SAS scores showed slight increase from end of acute phase during extension (endpoint LOCF +2.01)
MMSE worsening in aripiprazole arm vs placebo at Week 10 (p=0.001)

dose_info.schedule: Once daily; titrated: Week 1-2: 2 mg, Week 3-4: 2-5 mg, Week 5-6: 2-10 mg, Weeks 7-10: 2-15 mg (acute); similar titration in extension

context.indication: Psychosis associated with Alzheimer's type dementia
context.duration: Acute phase: 10 weeks; Extension phase: up to 130 additional weeks (total up to ~140 weeks); some patients treated beyond 140 weeks up to Week 328
